The standalone packaged code passes symbolic, exact rational and 480 seeded Fourier checks; finite trials support but do not establish the universal algebra.

value.rationale: Binary finite-aperture truncation is an explicit physical constraint in a recent optical preconditioner, and Type-II Schur inversion is a specified algorithm, so the object is not arbitrarily contrived. The exact theorem shows a phase change from an invertible regularized saddle solve to singular preconditioned one-step stagnation; quantifies loss in the physical data norm and a stronger global attenuation of retained signal than simple omitted-frequency bias. The well-conditioned SPD witness establishes an error mechanism not explainable as numerical ill-conditioning alone. The exact range-versus-Krylov gap is actionable for deciding whether to keep low-amplitude transmission, augment the subspace, or change preconditioning; no universal noisy-hardware conclusion is claimed.
